source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade and Downgrade DCSCM-CPLD firmware by Web when system is booted
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade DCSCM-CPLD firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + DCSCM-CPLD image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- DCSCM-CPLD upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided DCSCM-CPLD image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the DCSCM-CPLD flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with the SUT must be booted and the BMC web-UI reachable; an AC cycle is required after flash completes; after completion verify the DCSCM-CPLD version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the DCSCM-CPLD version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: DCSCM-CPLD firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; AC cycle after flash is mandatory; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

original_test_intent: Upgrade and downgrade the DCSCM-CPLD through the BMC WebUI with the host running, then perform the required AC cycle and verify that management-module programmable logic and the server recover correctly.
original_method: A human selects and commits each DCSCM-CPLD image in the WebUI, observes flash completion, performs the approved AC cycle, and checks the active version, BMC manageability, host boot and logs.
manual_activity: The destructive WebUI selection/commit/progress acceptance is the manual core; an engineer also controls any physical hand-off required by the approved AC-cycle method.
required_inputs: DCSCM-CPLD device identity, current/upgrade/downgrade versions and image hashes
Vendor WebUI update and post-AC activation procedure
AC controller, off/on dwell, count and host quiesce plan
Known-good recovery image, console and alternate management path
safety_requirements: Verify the image targets the DCSCM-CPLD revision, not another board CPLD; never infer target from filename alone.
Execute one approved transition and one unchanged AC plan; no automatic retry or repeat cycle.
Do not generalize Seq 182: this row requires an AC cycle but not physical cable removal.
Stop if management access, power restoration, CPLD activation or host boot is uncertain; preserve raw evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare immutable device/image evidence, baseline DCSCM/BMC/host state, log collection and power telemetry; collect independent post-AC inventory and health.
Do not perform or claim the manual WebUI core and do not issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve/perform the DCSCM-CPLD WebUI update and exact AC-cycle hand-off.
Assess active logic, BMC management, host recovery and final verdict per direction.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It captures the correct board component and AC activation, but browser automation cannot satisfy manual WebUI acceptance and a clean single reset is not a source requirement.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI manually; after the approved AC cycle, use the existing read-only IPMI raw version script only if its DCSCM field mapping is validated.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The booted-host condition, DCSCM-CPLD WebUI, AC cycle, script and 5/30-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED DCSCM-CPLD UPDATE WITH MANAGEMENT-PLANE RECOVERY CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the image to the exact DCSCM programmable device, capture WebUI terminal state, execute one controlled AC activation and verify DCSCM version plus BMC reachability, host POST/OS and SEL through independent paths.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems whose DCSCM-CPLD is supported by the named BMC WebUI update flow.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/WebUI/browser, DCSCM board/CPLD image, IPMI script mapping and power-controller versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor DCSCM-CPLD update/activation/recovery guide and project power SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact DCSCM target binding, management-plane recovery evidence and validated IPMI field mapping.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong-device image selection and post-AC loss of BMC/host management, not just an upload banner.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved DCSCM transition and power plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: DCSCM revisions may expose different CPLD inventory fields; validate readback before use as acceptance.

project_override_considerations: Project overrides may set DCSCM images, version order, readback field and AC timing. Completion is limited to that exact board revision and power plan.
expected_evidence: Approved DCSCM board/CPLD identity and image matrix
Manual WebUI image selection, progress and terminal status
Validated post-AC DCSCM inventory, BMC reachability and host boot/OS health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets a DCSCM-CPLD WebUI flash followed by AC cycle. Missing versions, power parameters and detailed acceptance are project inputs; DeepSeek's single-reset addition is not retained.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and target are clear enough to plan. V3.1 does not make project inputs permanent blocks; manual WebUI core controls classification.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps DCSCM and AC scope, rejects browser substitution and invented reset wording.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves its critical safeguards while changing BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds DCSCM management-plane recovery and validated inventory mapping without changing source intent.

review_improvement: Turns generic flash success into DCSCM-specific active-version and management-plane recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Because the DCSCM is part of the server management/control path, post-AC validation must include BMC reachability and host recovery. The source remains executable after project inputs, but its WebUI core is manual by policy.
